expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds fetching a URL (sockets/HTTP) with TODOs; no full browser
expectations.evidence: browser.py is a skeleton: '你的任务：填掉下面两个 TODO' with '# TODO 1: 解析 URL，拆出 scheme / host / port / path' and '# TODO 2: 建立 TCP 连接，发送请求，读回响应体' followed by '...' bodies; answer says '你来写：`browser.py` 里的两个 TODO' and '当前进度：里程碑 1/7' — no full browser implemented

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with checkpoint: 'python3 browser.py http://example.org' and '预期输出一段以 `<html>` 开头、含 "Example Domain" 的 HTML'

expectations.text: B3: Mentions sending an HTTP GET request and splitting headers/body at a blank line (\r\n\r\n)

Concept text: 'HTTP/1.1 请求就是一段按

' / '循环读响应头直到遇到空行；然后读出剩余的 body'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Commands run were only 'ls -la && python3 --version && python3 -c "import tkinter…"' and 'curl -s … http://example.org' — no installs; only file written is browser.py in project; Tk missing is delegated to learner: '届时你需要自己运行安装命令（macOS：`brew install python-tk@3.14`）'
